# proxmox_guest_firewall_ip_set_entry (Resource)

Manages an address, network, or alias entry in a QEMU/LXC firewall IP set. Guests must exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_firewall_ip_set_entry" "office" {
  node       = "pve-1"
  guest_type = "qemu"
  vmid       = 100
  ip_set     = proxmox_guest_firewall_ip_set.office.name
  cidr       = "192.0.2.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4/IPv6 address, CIDR network, or alias. Changes require replacement.
- `guest_type` (String) `qemu` or `lxc`. Changes require replacement.
- `ip_set` (String) Parent firewall IP set name. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node that runs the guest. Changes require replacement.
- `vmid` (Number) Guest VMID. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Entry comment.
- `nomatch` (Boolean) Exclude this entry from the IP set match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<guest_type>/<vmid>/<ip_set>/<cidr>` form.
